Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results. The search results clearly showed that "Cairo Declaration" is a 2015 Chinese film (released September 3, 2015). However, the Planner hallucinated a release year of 1943 in their analysis ("Obviously, Cairo Declaration (1943) predates..."). The year 1943 refers to the historical Cairo Declaration (the treaty), not the film. By inventing a release date of 1943 for the film, the Planner reversed the chronological order and concluded incorrectly that the Cairo Declaration film came out first, when in reality, "Natürlich Die Nelli" (1959) came out before "Cairo Declaration" (2015).
